messages.message: Node with a skinned mesh is not root. Parent transforms will not affect a skinned mesh.
Node with a skinned mesh is not root. Parent transforms will not affect a skinned mesh.

sourceProvenance.clipTimePolicy: Native durations; runtime maps contact phases

derivation.method: Continuous voxel-union anatomical sculpt; explicit facial and garment meshes; hand-authored normalized 24-joint skin; vertex-painted surfaces
limitations: Stylized interpretation of one frontal photograph; unseen rear surfaces invented.
Mesh and facial proportions are authored approximations, not photogrammetry.
referenceFeatures: solid cleaver with real circular hole

optimization.method: Upstream detail tessellation reduced; moderate body edge collapse with interpolated skin weights, renormalized to four influences. Held weapon geometry and all bind transforms retained.

recommended.status: Provisional separate-equipment coordinates, not captured geometry. Runtime owner handles equipped geometry and visual validation.

rawSkinnedBounds.method: CPU skinning: sum(weight * jointWorld * inverseBind * vertex); includes morphs
rawSkinnedBounds.limitation: Uniform time samples, not guaranteed continuous extrema

normalizedSkinnedBounds.method: CPU skinning: sum(weight * jointWorld * inverseBind * vertex); includes morphs
normalizedSkinnedBounds.limitation: Uniform time samples, not guaranteed continuous extrema
